title: DARPA and U.S. Government Research Angles, 2025-2026
summary: A reviewed collection of 23 recent DARPA, White House, defense, intelligence, energy, and congressional documents that reveal how federal research priorities connect frontier technology to industrial capacity, infrastructure, supply chains, resilience, and national security.
scope: The collection combines DARPA portfolio and solicitation evidence with current U.S. strategy and policy documents. It is designed to show the research directions, enabling systems, and implementation constraints that recur across the federal stack.
download_note: The bundle contains 22 official local captures plus an official-link record for the 2026 National Defense Strategy, whose host allowed reading but suppressed automated file export. It also includes the collection manifest and consolidated FTFN summaries.
method_note: Summaries distinguish stated priorities from funded execution, program awards, deployment, and local outcomes. Broad solicitations and strategy documents are treated as direction-setting evidence, not proof that a capability has been built.
